description: B23c: mid-tone target (EV on the Standard tone curve's input axis) = coef[0] + coef[1] * clamp(log2(p98_y / median_y), hi_range). Fitted from R5 II RAW + camera JPEG pairs (redline_cal.metering); exposure compensation of auto-exposure shots taken out.

headroom.description: B23c.1: when log2(median / p25) >= split_min_ev and the clipped fraction <= clipped_max, raise the target so log2(p98 / median) + target reaches p98_floor_ev (EV on the tone curve's input axis), by at most lift_max_ev. Fitted on the train split (redline_cal.metering.fit_headroom).
